\[
\gamma_a(I) = \bigvee \{ \gamma_B(I) : B \text{ connected},\ \lvert B \rvert \ge a \}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(a\): The area
- \(B\): A connected structuring element

Threshold the image at every level. At each level, the bright pixels split into connected components. The area opening removes every component with fewer than a pixels, so a pixel drops to the highest level at which it still belongs to a large enough component. Vincent showed this equals the supremum of all openings with connected structuring elements of at least a pixels. So no fixed shape is imposed, and what is kept is kept exactly. scikit-image computes it on a max-tree, after Salembier, Oliveras and Garrido.
